rules: Recovery first reopens the exact raw proof/owner and runs the current prepare_recording unchanged: source/journal/hash, native structure/admission, selected provenance, codec, every retained/excluded packet and clock, full decode. Existing media existence, size/mtime or prior library metadata never substitutes for this proof.

The consuming handoff retains exact source identity, expected candidate length/hash and source loss facts. Its existing job root determines the sole target media.mp4. No supplied filename, directory scan, newest merge search or foreign-job adoption.

In explicit Recovery mode, from Prepared only, open the fixed final with READ access and share-READ only, OPEN_REPARSE_POINT and the existing exact FileKey/single-link/regular/ancestor guards. Retain this immutable handle through completion. Match expected length immediately and use verify_installed for full expected-hash equality outside the service mutex. The proof is content equality to the newly verified same-source candidate, not an assertion about the historical creator of the existing file.

Adoption performs no rename, write, truncate, overwrite, delete or modified-time change to the existing final. Prepared becomes Installed(adopted), then Verified only after the normal full hash/guards. Retain the newly generated merge candidate and all attempts/raw/chat on disk. A failed transition latches Failed; do not reuse a failed handoff.

Only an explicit NotFound from the fixed final lookup may leave Prepared and use normal no-replace install in Recovery mode. Other open/metadata/hash errors fail closed. Do not catch a generic rename failure and reinterpret it as successful adoption. A final created after a NotFound check still causes the ordinary no-replace collision.

Reuse current full identity/root/request/video/broadcast, current revision, exact cancel Arc, no-library/no-shutdown CAS and JobOwnership lifetime. Acquire/choose the fixed file under the same short ownership fence as install; do full hash and chat I/O outside the state mutex; recheck exact held file/source and attempt before durable completed journal save. A newer attempt, cancellation or shutdown must not be overwritten.

Reuse verified duration, captureOutcome and current chat recovery without resetting partial/interrupted/unknown states. Preserve chat-timeline.json, youtube-raw-anchor.json, marker/status/catalog/shards/assets. Never mint remux-wall timing or upgrade missing chat evidence merely because final media matches.

After any failure preserve existing final, new candidate, source and last truthful journal. No rollback or deletion. A previously completed durable journal is loaded normally and must not create a second library item. Hash differences caused by older output formats/tools remain explicit retained collisions; no weaker packet-only fallback or silent migration in this batch.
acceptance: Windows handle regression: exact fixed existing bytes are adopted without rename or mtime/FileKey change; held target denies writers/deleters through commit; new merge/raw/chat bytes remain unchanged. New mode still rejects an existing target even when identical.

Reject same-size different bytes, wrong length/root/full source identity, reparse/hardlink/directory, path replacement, unsupported access, stale revision/cancel owner and expired/cancelled/shutdown attempts. All failures preserve final/source/journal and cannot later reuse the same terminal handoff.

Fault-inject after real install and before completed journal persistence on isolated owned fixtures, drop old service/handles, reload the interrupted job, explicitly retry through raw recovery, recompute the real candidate and adopt byte-identical existing media. Assert one completed journal/library item, expected hash/duration/outcome, restart-open/range reads and unchanged existing final plus source/chat hashes.

Inject cancellation/owner replacement during adopted-file verification and another completed-journal failure. No stale completion or deletion; a subsequent separately owned retry can succeed after fresh verification. Exercise NotFound-to-normal-install and target-created-after-NotFound collision.

Exercise partial selected provenance and sticky partial/unknown chat as well as a clean stopped fixture. Verify original timeline/anchor and chat content unchanged. A missing or mismatched source proof cannot adopt even a valid playable final.

Simulate durable completed journal followed by service recreation before in-memory success: load the existing entry, reject duplicate retry/publication and retain one library item. Keep existing AVC/SOOP/CHZZK behavior unchanged.

Root owns all serial tests/build/media runs. A real regenerated candidate must demonstrate exact byte equality; if it differs, preserve the collision and report the unresolved compatibility case instead of weakening the hash gate. Actual UI/player recovery remains unverified until separately permitted and exercised; Computer Use Escape stop and main-app launch restriction remain in force.
nonGoals: No source/intermediate cleanup, historical bulk adoption, automatic retry scheduling, new network/media ingress, auth/account action, UI change, forced process exit, release or claim of general power-loss atomicity. Implementation authority is limited to the explicit approved files and rules above.
